title: First order - awesome - Second order - GARBAGE!
text: First order - awesome - Second order - GARBAGE!. I ordered these pillows some time ago and they were wonderful and well worth the money.  As a result of this experience, i came back to order another set and did so in Feb-2021.  These are simply NOT THE SAME PILLOW!  I treated them exactly the same as the first order and the recent order was DISAPPOINTING to say the least They are lumpy and impossible to get a good night's sleep!  Many companies seem to fall into the trap of trying to sell a cheaper and sub par product to increase their profit margin after they receive several good reviews.  I can't be sure but this seems to be the case for this product.  I CANNOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT - was great initially but has changed and IS NOT WORTH THE COST!  DO NOT BUY!
